lesson.title: Discovering Yemen
lesson.title_ar: اكتشاف اليمن: وصف المشهد الجبلي من القريب إلى البعيد والاستنتاج حول الركاب والوجهة

lines: Describe what you can see - first the two four-wheel-drives in the foreground and then the things further away in the distance.
Now say what you think about the picture. Where must it have been taken? Who do you think the people in the four-wheel-drives are? Where might they be going? Give reasons.
Now do activities A to B in the Workbook.
content.caption: Two four-wheel-drives climbing a rocky track in the mountains (PB page 48)

blocks.edu_note_html:
ملاحظات نقل حرفي وتوثيق كاسيت (PB p. 48 & WB p. 78):
1) طُبعت عبارة Now do activities A to B in the Workbook. بحرف الجر to بين حرفين متتاليين بدل A and B، وحُفظت حرفياً.
2) يتطلب التمرين WB 6.10 B (Listen to the first part of the conversation) الشريط الصوتي لتعيين المتحدثين داخل السيارة بالضبط ومراجعة ما يُسمع، وسُجّل ذلك في REVIEW_NEEDED.md.

interactive_spot.label: الفرق في ترتيب الوصف بين 6.2 و6.10 وصيغ الاستنتاج

simple_explain.html:
• عكس اتجاه الوصف: في درس 6.2 بدأنا من البعيد إلى القريب؛ أما هنا في 6.10 فنبدأ من المقدّمة إلى الأفق (first the two four-wheel-drives in the foreground and then... in the distance).
  • توظيف أفعال الاستنتاج (الوحدة 5): استعمل must have + P.P. للقطع القوي بالمكان (It must have been taken in Yemen) وmight be + V-ing / may be لاحتمال الوجهة والهوية.

example.html: Deduction with reasons: The picture must have been taken in the Yemeni mountains because of the stone terraced houses and rocky steep tracks; the passengers might be tourists going on an expedition because the roof racks carry lots of bags.

activities.prompt_literal: 6.10 A Write in your copybooks about the picture on PB page 48. Paragraph 1: Write your description. Paragraph 2: Write what you thought about the picture.
activities.prompt_ar: نموذج كتابة فقرتَي وصف الصورة والتفكير الاستنتاجي حولها (WB 6.10 A ص 78):
activities.guidance_literal: Paragraph 1 (foreground -> distance) | Paragraph 2 (where must it have been taken + who + where going + reasons)

steps.label_ar: Paragraph 1 — الوصف الحسي من المقدّمة إلى البعيد (What you can see)
steps.placeholder: In the foreground, there are two dusty four-wheel-drives loaded with luggage climbing a rough, stony mountain track, with two palm trees on the left. Further away in the middle distance, you can see traditional Yemeni stone houses built along the hillside, and high steep mountains in the far distance.

steps.label_ar: Paragraph 2 — الاستنتاج والتفكير المعلّل (Where / Who / Why)
steps.placeholder: This picture must have been taken in the Yemeni highlands because of the traditional tower houses and mountain scenery. I think the people inside the cars are tourists with a local driver and guide because they look excited and are carrying heavy bags on the roof racks. They might be travelling to remote mountain villages to discover Yemen.

hints: ابدأ الفقرة 1 بعبارة In the foreground وانتهٍ بعبارة In the distance / Further away.

activities.prompt_literal: 6.10 B Listen to the first part of the conversation and do these activities. 1 Find the speakers in the picture on PB page 48. 2 Listen to check what you wrote in paragraph 2. Note that it will not be exactly the same.
activities.prompt_ar: توجيهات نشاط الاستماع 6.10 B (يتطلب تشغيل الشريط الصوتي مع المعلّم — WB ص 78):

items.question: 1 Find the speakers in the picture on PB page 48. / 2 Listen to check what you wrote in paragraph 2.
items.model_answer: [يتطلب الشريط الصوتي المرافق لتحديد الأشخاص المتحدثين بدقة داخل السيارة الأمامية ومقارنة التفاصيل المسموعة بما كتبته في الفقرة 2 (علماً أن عنوان الوحدة والدرس التالي 6.11 يوضحان أن الرحلة كانت بصحبة السائق اليمني فيصل حاتم القاضي والصحفي المصوّر].
items.explain_ar: عملاً بالقاعدة 7 لا تُخمَّن أدوار المتحدثين الفردية دون الشريط السماعي.

hints: قارن بعد الاستماع مع المعلّم ما توقعته في الفقرة الثانية من 6.10 A.

questions.stem: How does the description order requested on PB page 48 (6.10) differ from PB page 42 (6.2)?

options.text: Lesson 6.10 starts with the foreground (the two four-wheel-drives) and moves to the distance, whereas 6.2 starts furthest away.
Lesson 6.10 describes only the background sky and ignores the vehicles.
options.why_wrong: يبدأ التوجيه صراحةً بسيارتَي الدفع الرباعي في المقدمة ثم ما يبعد في الأفق.

options.text: Both 6.2 and 6.10 strictly forbid mentioning the foreground.
options.why_wrong: كلا الدرسين يستعملان التعبيرين In the foreground وIn the distance.

options.text: Lesson 6.10 uses Past passive to describe surgical operations.
options.why_wrong: هذا يصف درس 6.5 عن عملية أنور لا مشهد اكتشاف اليمن.

hints: اقرأ عبارة التوجيه الأولى: first the two four-wheel-drives in the foreground and then the things further away in the distance.
questions.explain: في 6.2 طُلب البدء بالأبعد (Start with the things furthest away)، أما في 6.10 فطُلب البدء بالمقدّمة ثم الأبعد.

questions.stem: In PB page 48, which detail in the illustration best supports the deduction 'The people in the four-wheel-drives might be tourists travelling far'?

options.text: Both 4WDs are packed with luggage on their roof racks on a steep mountain track passing traditional hillside houses.
They are parked outside a harbour fishing boat called D173.
options.why_wrong: قارب الصيد D173 يخص مشهد الميناء في الوحدة 5 (5.1).

options.text: A police highway patrol officer is interviewing a motorbike rider beside a tunnel.
options.why_wrong: هذا يخص مشهد الحادث في درس 6.2.

options.text: Doctors are examining a patient on an ambulance stretcher.
options.why_wrong: هذا يخص لوحات إنقاذ أنور في درس 6.4.

hints: انظر إلى سطحَي السيارتين والحمولة والطريق الجبلي الوعر في pb48_discovering_yemen.webp.
